The experts agreed Warhol's silkscreen changed the photograph's meaning, from Prince's private identity to his public image. The majority held that this did not matter for the use at issue: a magazine cover illustrating a story about Prince serves substantially the photograph's own purpose, and new meaning counts only as evidence of a different purpose.
